Agents can ask each other for help again, and you decide whom each agent may ask.

## What's in 1.12.0

**Agents can ask another agent.** An agent stuck on one missing answer can send a question to another agent instead of stopping for you. It keeps the task, and the answer wakes it. The agent working rules still tell it to do its own work end to end, and asking is a last resort.

**You choose whom each agent may ask.** Each agent's profile has **Can ask other agents**: No agents, Its line (the managers above it and the agents below it) or Any agent. Its line is the default. Owners and admins set it, and the core refuses any question the setting does not allow.

**Limits on every task.** A task can have one open question to an agent at a time, and three in all. Only the agent asked, or a person, can answer. Questions to people work as before.

**See how often agents ask.** `kyoube doctor` has an **agent questions** line with each company's counts for the past week.

**A new home on GitHub.** KyoubeAI now lives at github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI, and the image at `ghcr.io/kyoubeai/kyoubeai`. The old addresses still work, and `./update.sh` moves your install to the new image as it updates.

## Update

From 1.11, run `./update.sh`. It backs up first, and `./update.sh --rollback` returns to 1.11. There are no database migrations. Within a minute of the start, every agent's working rules move to the new version, and each agent may ask its line. To stop an agent asking, set **Can ask other agents** to No agents.

How to turn agent questions off for every agent is in [docs/agent-rules.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/agent-rules.md#agent-questions). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
